subject.title: fix(claude-cli): max-turn stops omit run and recovery context

question: Should recognized Claude CLI max-turn terminal results always be surfaced without profile rotation or configured-model fallback because prior tool effects may have occurred?
rationale: The implementation is correct and upstream terminal handling favors duplicate prevention, but disabling configured fallback is an intentional runtime availability-versus-side-effect policy that OpenClaw maintainers must own.

options.title: Keep terminal non-replay
options.body: Surface every recognized max-turn result immediately and require users to verify effects before manually retrying.

options.title: Gate on tool-use signal
options.body: Suppress replay only when `stop_reason` reports `tool_use`, retaining fallback availability for other max-turn results.

options.title: Retain automatic fallback
options.body: Merge only the diagnostic improvements and continue profile/model replay despite possible duplicate effects.

recommendation.title: Keep terminal non-replay
recommendation.body: Surface every recognized max-turn result immediately and require users to verify effects before manually retrying.

likelyOwner.reason: Their latest merged work owns the adjacent terminal classification across both affected CLI runner paths.
